quarterly_data.quarter: INNIO press release: INNIO Expands Waukesha Site to Meet Growing Demand for (08-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: INNIO plans to invest more than $300 million in its Waukesha, Wisconsin facility and to create more than 500 jobs over the coming years. To support increasing U.S. customer demand it plans to add new engine assembly capabilities at the site, plus an advanced engine testing facility exceeding 80,000 square feet and office and shop-floor renovations. Engines produced in Waukesha power U.S. critical infrastructure including data centers, power grids and industrial operations; the company says the expansion brings production closer to customers and strengthens its ability to serve the rapidly growing data center sector. The campus spans approximately 1.7 million square feet, including nearly 890,000 square feet of manufacturing and operational space, and currently hosts remanufacturing, repair and overhaul operations; alongside the U.S. facilities in Trenton, New Jersey and Waller, Texas, it serves as a key regional hub to reduce lead times while increasing capacity. Waukesha CEO Roger George: 'The expansion underscores our commitment to local value creation in the United States and to meeting the growing demand for decentralized energy solutions'.
quarterly_data.figure: more than $300 million investment; more than 500 jobs; engine testing facility exceeding 80,000 square feet
